svg.title: Workflow of Cultivating Heedfulness and Skillful Qualities

g.text: Workflow of Cultivating Heedfulness and Skillful Qualities
The Dhamma provides a guide for personal development
for the ending of suffering and the realization of unbinding.
Heedfulness is the foremost among all skillful qualities.
Guard mind from defilements and actions leading to harm
Ensure benefits in this life and lives to come
Appropriate attention is the specific mental process by which heedfulness is applied.
Generate desire, endeavor, persistence for abandoning
Roots of unskillful actions: Greed, Aversion, Delusion.
Confess and disclose faults if committed
Generate desire, endeavor, persistence for developing
Roots of skillful actions: Lack of Greed, Aversion, Delusion.
Maintain proper pitch of persistence (not over-aroused or slack)
Practice Recollection (Buddha, Dhamma, Saṅgha, own virtues, breathing)
Mind becomes pliant, malleable, luminous, not brittle
Mind becomes rightly concentrated for ending effluents
Leads to growth and abundance in Dhamma-Vinaya
Continuously Cultivate Noble Eightfold Path (Right View as forerunner)
Knowledge of stress, its origination, cessation, and path to cessation.
Explore meaning of Dhamma, quiz teachers for clarification
Teach Dhamma without harm, lead by example, encourage others.
Engage in Right Interaction with Others
